# Wi-Fi / Bluetooth on or off (`radio.set`)

**Kind:** action · **Category:** Network & devices · **Runs as:** the signed-in user · **Revertible:** yes

Turns a wireless radio on, off, or toggles it.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `radio` | one of: `wifi`, `bluetooth`, `mobile_broadband` | yes |  | Which radio. |
| `state` | one of: `on`, `off`, `toggle` | yes |  | on, off, or toggle. |
| `continue_on_error` | true / false | no | `false` | Keep running the next actions even if this one fails. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: radio.set
    radio: bluetooth
    state: off
```

## In profiles

When this action is part of a [profile](../../guide/profiles.md), the current value is saved before it runs and
restored when the profile is reverted. Two actions of this type change the same setting when their `radio` is the same.

## Notes

Windows may deny radio access if 'Let apps control device radios' is turned off in Privacy settings.
